mapping.summary: Touch-friendly shop floor screen for production orders
claims: Touch-friendly work screen for released production orders
Start, pause, resume and finish operations with live timers; setup time separate from run time
Reports output, scrap and extra component consumption via standard journals
Creates inventory movements for components of an operation and blocks completion until registered
Material log showing theoretical vs reported quantity before posting
Planned breaks automatically pause running operations, then resume them
Registers non-production time along with clock-in and clock-out
Multiple operators per operation with own registrations
Order and operation notes stored on the production order
Audit trail per operator and operation
Users only see assigned work centers
No extra full BC licenses for the shop floor
